remarks: Looking for a private yet convenient townhouse in Norwalk, CT? Look no further. Walk through your private entryway to an open concept floor plan - perfect for day-to-day living as well as entertaining. Whip up a meal in the large kitchen before heading into the dining room to enjoy a meal with friends and family. Light a fire in the fireplace and snuggle up with a movie or enjoy a game night. A half bath completes this level. Long day? Head up to the main bedroom suite with a full bath where the vaulted ceilings and natural light create and warm and airy feel. Perfect for relaxing. An additional spacious bedroom and full bath complete this level. Plenty of storage. Assigned parking space. Minutes to shops, restaurants, entertainment, the Merritt and more! Walking distance to the train. A must see!
